anchor: ONS Sickness absence in the UK labour market, 2025 edition, Tables 4, 4a and 5, reason categories and non-disclosure response; published 1 May 2026.
notes: OWHS codes map to the ten substantive ONS reason categories and the separate non-disclosure response shown in the 2025 workbook. The codes are OWHS identifiers; the labels retain the source category names without footnote markers. This replaces an incomplete six-category list. Category alignment alone does not establish comparability between employer episode records and the Labour Force Survey's weighted population estimates. Other means the residual source category; it does not mean unknown or prefers not to give details. Legacy v0.1.0 Other values cannot be expanded into these categories without additional source information.

values.label: Other
values.note: Source residual category; see workbook notes 12 and 13. Not an unspecified or non-disclosure code.

values.label: Prefers not to give details
values.note: Non-disclosure response, not a clinical reason. Preserve separately from Other and from missing data.
